title: Self-Blinding and Counterfactual Self-Simulation Mitigate Biases and Sycophancy in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model logit scores for favorable decisions in templated scenarios where racial attributes (Asian, Black, Hispanic, white) are counterbalanced and compared against a blinded baseline where race is redacted.

Comparing model logit scores for favorable decisions in templated scenarios where gender attributes and pronouns are counterbalanced and compared against a blinded baseline using gender-neutral terms.

Measuring the difference in log probabilities of a model supporting a specific party's position in a 2-party dispute when that position is framed as belonging to the user ('me') versus the opposing party ('them').
